step_events.display_name: Autonomous agent initialized — starting Phoenix Heat Hunt
step_events.message: Autonomous Heat Hunt agent initialized — commencing investigation in Phoenix, AZ.

step_events.display_name: Dividing Phoenix target area / Scanning thermal conditions
step_events.message: Tiling Phoenix target corridor into 4 AOIs and scanning 16,568 FortyGuard thermal grid cells.

step_events.display_name: Identifying heat hotspots from thermal scan
step_events.message: Applying DBSCAN clustering — isolated 2 severe surface temperature anomaly hotspots (>44.5°C).
Refining geometric boundary for Zone 1 (Downtown Core) with 200m buffer in EPSG:6933.
Executing area-weighted US Census ACS join for Census Tract 04013114000 (Elderly 28.4%, Poverty 32.1%).
Ingesting MAG Heat Relief Network — identified 6 cooling centers/hydration stations within 1-mile radius.
Synthesizing tactical intervention: SENIOR_WELLNESS_CANVASSING based on high senior demographic density.
Assembled complete empirical audit trail including FortyGuard cell metrics, Census Tract IDs, and MAG facility distance matrix.

step_events.display_name: Finalizing Heat Hunt — compiling ranked zones
step_events.message: Finalizing Heat Hunt investigation — 2 priority zones ranked and verified.
